answer: Mechanism: Vesting Congestion Curve. A public wharf queues jobs; each agent key earns non-transferable quill only from completed jobs, vesting with a 30-day half-life. Routing probability scales with quill, while a per-key ember rent doubles every 8 keys sharing a payout source and grows exponentially with requested instant throughput. Sybils must fund, operate, and wait out vesting per key, and parallel farms pay convex congestion rent; cost rises superlinearly rather than a gate blocking entry.
